title: Allocation of land plots from Regional Industrial Estates to set up new Industries
decision_details: - The selection of investors for investment in Industrial Estates is carried out by the "Regional Industrial Service Committee" established in accordance with the provisions of the Industrial Promotion Act, No.46 of 1990 and the "Project Evaluation Committee of the Ministry" appointed by the Secretary to the Ministry. Accordingly, the Project Evaluation Committee of the Ministry has recommended the allocation of land plots as well, for 38 investment projects from among the 42 project proposals recommended by the Regional Industrial Service Committees. The total value of investments to be made by the said 38 investors is Rs.2,548.22 million, and it is also expected to generate about 1,559 direct employment opportunities through those industrial projects. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to provide land plots from the relevant industrial estates on lease basis for a maximum period of 35 years to the said investors, was approved by the Cabinet.
